_doc: The UHV-breakout rulebook — the stencil Zee curates. Each rule is atomic, named, in the master's words, with mechanical params. The engine (rulebook_engine.py) extracts features from a candidate setup (bars + origin/uhv/breakout indices) and a setup is VALID only if every ENABLED + REQUIRED rule passes. SOFT rules are quality flags (don't reject). Zee edits this file (toggle enabled, tune params, add rules).

rules.words: Uptrend = camel humps = HH+HL. I look at ONE hump right before the retracement begins. 1 hump is enough usually.
Our formula doesn't work in a ranging/choppy market. Ranging = an up-leg AND a down-leg both present, no dominant direction.
A valid retracement starts when a counter-trend candle's BODY breaks the previous same-direction candle's extreme (BUY: red closes below prev green's low; SELL: green closes above prev red's high).
UHV = the highest-volume counter-trend candle WITHIN the valid retracement, and it must be a local volume peak (bigger than its neighbours). Right colour: red for BUY, green for SELL.
We mark only ONE breakout — the FIRST candle whose body crosses the UHV's extreme. Not a later candle.
Breakout candle must be the opposite colour of the UHV — green for a buy, red for a sell.
The breakout candle's volume must be LOWER than the UHV's volume.
The breakout should be a momentum candle (strong body).
Weak if there's a big rejection wick against the breakout direction.
